# Isaiah Chapter 26 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 21 verses]*

*Strong city; perfect peace; the dead shall live; hide until wrath passes*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 26 (Song of Trust) addresses strong city; perfect peace; the dead shall live; hide until wrath passes. The key verse — "You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in you" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
